Notice.description: Told about a payload the server saw. The client implements it and hands it over; the server calls it back across the seam.

Stop.description: Asks the server to stop sending notices. Releasing the reference to it is not this, and cancelling the call that returned it is neither.

Watcher.description: An interface, which is a record of callable members; each member is its own binding, with its own lifetime.

fields.name: notice
fields.description: Called once for every payload the server sees while the subscription lasts.

Subscription.description: What watch answers: a record of callables the client calls back, held apart from the call that returned it.

Watch.description: A callable supplied as an argument, beside ordinary data.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What to call this subscription; data, and carried as data.

fields.name: watcher
fields.description: The interface the server calls back.

watch.description: Takes a callback and answers a record of callables: a live reference travels in each direction within one call.
